title: Pontotoc post office closes Thanksgiving Day. Here are the holiday mailing dates
excerpt: Regular delivery and counter service resume Friday, Nov. 27. USPS gives three December send-by dates for cards and packages traveling within the lower 48 states.
locality: U.S. Postal Service in Pontotoc, Mississippi, with national service dates applying locally.

paragraphs.text: The post office at 305 Highway 15 North in Pontotoc will close Thursday, Nov. 26, for Thanksgiving. Regular mail delivery and service at the counter resume Friday, Nov. 27, according to the U.S. Postal Service.

Anyone who needs postage while the counter is closed can use Click-N-Ship to prepare and print a prepaid shipping label. USPS also takes stamp orders, mail-hold requests and post office box renewals online during the holiday.
For cards and packages traveling within the lower 48 states, USPS recommends mailing by Thursday, Dec. 17, for expected arrival before Christmas if using First-Class Mail or Ground Advantage.

The recommended date for Priority Mail is Friday, Dec. 18. For Priority Mail Express it is Saturday, Dec. 19. Ground shipments outside the lower 48 can take longer. USPS says Ground Advantage between the contiguous states and places including Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico can take 10 days or more.
